info.title: Melostore H2H Public API
info.description: Public partner API. Two authentication headers are required together unless an operation explicitly has security=[]. Fictional order creation examples set sandbox_mode=true; omitted/null mode uses the account setting. Enter the Webhook URL in the dashboard. Rotate Keys generates the API Key, Secret Key, and Webhook Secret together and shows them once; later rotations replace all three immediately. Update API credentials and the webhook receiver secret after rotation.

get.description: Look up your transaction by UUID or buyer_trx_id. Supports regular, Smart and individual bulk orders; use billing.transaction_id for paid account checks. Match Smart results using id/buyer_trx_id, as sku_code may differ from the ordered SKU. fulfilled_sku_code identifies the successfully fulfilled SKU. Account-check buyer_trx_id, sku_code and serial_number are null. Smart/bulk fields appear only for their order type.
get.x-description-id: Cari transaksi Anda melalui UUID atau buyer_trx_id. Berlaku untuk reguler, Smart, dan setiap pesanan bulk; gunakan billing.transaction_id untuk pemeriksaan akun berbayar. Cocokkan hasil Smart melalui id/buyer_trx_id karena sku_code dapat berbeda dari SKU yang dipesan. fulfilled_sku_code menunjukkan SKU yang berhasil dipenuhi. buyer_trx_id, sku_code, dan serial_number pemeriksaan akun bernilai null. Field Smart/bulk hanya muncul sesuai jenis pesanan.

post.summary: Per-transaction result sent to partner-configured webhook URL
post.description: Enter the Webhook URL in the dashboard. Rotate Keys generates the API Key, Secret Key and Webhook Secret together and shows them once; update your API credentials and receiver secret after each rotation. Callbacks report success/failed for API orders, including each transaction in a bulk. Orders placed manually through the dashboard do not send callbacks. Verify the raw body using HMAC-SHA256 with Webhook Secret, safely handle duplicate deliveries and return 2xx after saving the event. price_charged is the transaction price before any refund; check your balance and invoice for final costs.

parameters.description: Hex HMAC-SHA256 of the exact raw body using webhook_secret
